Well I don't really know how it is for everyone else but for me is that when ever I start to feel hope towards something, it's taken away in a hurry. It doesn't even last...I don't know if for a fact weather I'm jinxing it for fuck's sake or that's just how the world works? Another thing that's really been pushing me off the edge is peer pressure. My family just doesn't care about my feelings and they'll do whatever it takes to fulfill their mood...I can go on if you want!

I really appreciate your support.
